name: sdlc-agent-loop
description: The six-agent closed loop for AI-Assisted-Software-Development: Product Understanding, Incident Learning, Change Impact Analysis, Code Correction, and Feature Build. Traces blast radius on a diff, cites past incidents that touched the same code, proposes a test-validated safeguard PR, and builds a signed Design from the web app: tests its claims against your code, then writes a self-checked draft PR.
